senses.gloss:
m. (-ल)
A fire in a forest.
E.
मकि to adorn, aff. इलच्.

m. (-रः)
A mirror.
E.
मकि to adorn, उरच् aff., and the nasal retained; also मकुर and मुकुर.

mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
1 Bathing or drowning; any thing, or person.
2 Cleaning any thing by immersion.
E.
मस्ज to bathe, aff. तृच्, and नुम् augment.

n. (-णं)
Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; it is sometimes read मङ्क्षण.

ind.
1 Quickly, swiftly, instantly.
2 Much, exceedingly.
E.
मस्ज to purify, सु aff., and नुम् augment.

n. (-णं)
Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; in some parts of India a sort of iron chain-work petticoat, coming down to the knees, is still worn.

m. (-ङ्खः)
A mendicant of a particular order.
E.
मखि to go, अच् aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The head of a boat.
E.
मगि to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Lucky, fortunate, prosperous, faring well or happily.
n. (-लं)
1 Happiness, good fortune.
2 Preserving property, taking care of what has been gained, prudence, carefulness.
m. (-लः)
1 The planet MARS.
2 Burnt offering on various occasions of rejoicing.
f. (-ला)
1 A name of UMĀ, the wife of ŚIVA.
2 A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon,) with white blossoms.
3 A virtuous and obedient wife.
4 The mother of the fifth Jina or Jaina teacher SUMATI.
5 A species of Cæsalpinia.
E.
मगि to go, अलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-यः)
Waved leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.)
E.
मङ्गल prosperous, lucky, and च्छाया shade.

m. (-कः)
A bard, an encomiast.
E.
मङ्गल good fortune, and पाठक who reads or recites.

f. (-दा)
Turmeric.
E.
मङ्गल auspiciousness, and प्रदा bestowing.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
1 Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness, prosperity, &c.
2 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable.
3 Pure, pious.
m. (-ल्यः)
1 A plant, commonly Trāyamāṇa.
2 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
3 The Vilva, (Ægle marmelos.)
4 A sort of pulse, (Cicer lens.)
f. (-ल्या)
1 A fragrant sort of Agallochum or aloe wood.
2 A kind of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.)
3 A herb, commonly Gojihva, (Hieracium, or according to Rox.'s Catalogue, a herb of the same class, Elephantopus scaber.)
4 A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
5 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
6 A sort of perfume, commonly Rochana.
7 A kind of Orris root, (Acorus calamus.)
n. (-ल्यं)
1 Sour curds.
2 Sandal.
3 Red lead.
4 Gold.
E.
मङ्गल prosperous, and यत् aff.

n. (-ल्यं)
Welfare, propitiousness.
E.
मङ्गल, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
Lentils, (Cicer lens.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-या)
A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
E.
मङ्गल्य auspicious, नामधेया appellation.

f. (-नी)
A boat.
E.
मङ्ग the head of a boat, aff. इनि.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Propitious, tending to good fortune, wishing for it, indicating or portending it, &c.
E.
मङ्गल, and ठञ् aff.
